# deezy find

Lists the files the inputs (paths, folders or glob patterns) match, as an encode would find them.

<!-- BEGIN generated by scripts/cli_docs.py: edit the parsers in deezy/cli, not this block -->

```text {.scrollable-code-block}
usage: DeeZy find [-h] [-n] INPUT [INPUT ...]

positional arguments:
  INPUT       Input file paths or directories

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  -n, --name  Only display names instead of full paths.
```

<!-- END generated -->

## Examples

- Full paths:

```bash
deezy find "media/*.mkv"
```

- Only the file names, searching sub-folders:

```bash
deezy find -n "media/**/*.mkv"
```
